name: Metadata Decorator
description: Enriches records with derived metadata attributes at pipeline boundaries without altering the original payload semantics. Adds columns such as ingestion timestamp, source version, partition hints, or lineage tags as sidecar fields.
when_to_use: Downstream consumers need lineage or origin metadata
Partition pruning benefits from injected hints
drawbacks: Metadata drift if version not bumped
use_cases: Kafka header injection for source version
